subject: Vendor acceptance & billing handoff — Avicor pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Hill <tom.hill@avicor.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor acceptance & billing handoff — Avicor pilot

Hi Tom — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot into procurement: 

Summary of call
- Pilot: 3-month evaluation, 2 dedicated instances for production-like load testing.
- Decision criteria: latency SLOs, token cost per 1M, and data residency controls.
- Economic buyer: CFO (Tom — you confirmed Sarah Yates will sign PO).

Action items / asks for procurement intake
1) Invoicing entity: please confirm whether invoices should go to "Avicor Health, Inc." or to the parent: "Avicor Holdings LLC" and the remit address.
2) Billing contact & PO flow: share payables email and whether your AP requires a PO number before invoice processing.
3) Security evidence: if you can share the SOC2 snapshot and vendor intake portal link, we’ll attach to our vendor packet.
4) Expected committee date: you mentioned finance meets 5/18 — can you confirm if that’s the earliest approval window?

I attached a short vendor packet (vendor intake checklist + standard SOW template) to speed operations. If helpful, Ben can join the call with your payables team to walk through pricing and PO terms.

Proposed timeline
- 5/10: Avicor returns invoicing entity + payables contact + SOC2 link
- 5/12: Redwood sends finalized SOW and vendor onboarding form
- 5/18–5/20: Procurement/Finance decision window

Thanks — I’ll follow up if I don’t hear back by EOD Monday.

—
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Tom Hill <tom.hill@avicor.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@avicor.ai>, Finance Ops <payables@avicor.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor acceptance & billing handoff — Avicor pilot

Chloe — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below and a couple of additions from our side.

1) Invoicing entity: "Avicor Holdings LLC" is the correct invoicing entity for any vendor contract. Remit to the address below: 1205 Harbor Way, Suite 400, Boston, MA 02110.
2) PO requirement: Yes, we require a PO for payments > $5k. For pilot, finance will want a master PO that references the SOW line items.
3) Payables contact: payables@avicor.ai (copied). They handle PO issuance and invoice processing.
4) Committee: Procurement lead indicated the earliest vendor acceptance review is 5/18 (they meet weekly). If you can provide SOC2 and the vendor intake form by 5/12, we should be in time for the 5/18 review.

CC'ing Sara (security) and payables so they have the packet in their queue. Sara — can you confirm if Avicor requires completed vendor risk questionnaire (VRQ) or if the SOC2 summary is sufficient for a pilot?

Best,
Tom
SVP Product, Avicor Health
Tom.Hill@avicor.ai

Chloe/Tom — attaching what I could pull together quickly. For pilots we usually accept a SOC2 summary + a completed high-level VRQ (5–8 questions) for low-risk vendors. For anything that touches PHI we do a deeper review — for this pilot the data will be tokenized and isolated, so the summary should be fine.

Attached: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, vendor_vrq_avicor_filled.pdf (filled — includes answers about encryption, data residency, subcontractors).

Notes:
- Please include a point in your SOW about logging retention and access controls; that’s one of our checklist items.
- Finance: to generate the PO we need proposed invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly) and estimated total for the pilot.

Sara Lopez

sara.lopez@avicor.ai

Thanks Sara — and Tom — looping on the billing items. A few clarifying points from our side to make the PO straightforward: 

1) Pricing & cadence: For the pilot we propose a monthly invoice tied to actual usage with a cap of $18,000/month (covers two dedicated instances + support). If you prefer a fixed milestone invoice, we can draft a three-month prepay amount.
2) Invoice detail: We’ll include line items for "Dedicated compute (instance-hours)", "Support (standard)", and "Data egress & storage" so your AP can map to GL codes.
3) Statement in SOW: We will add a logging retention clause (retention: 90 days) and encryption-at-rest language.

If Finance can share the PO template (or a sample PO number format), I can pre-populate the SOW with the PO reference so it can be attached directly to invoices.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
